# Timezone

The timezone of the host. `osapi dsl behavior get --name timezone` and
`osapi dsl behavior method get` show the same.

## Method get

|             |                                                                                                                                    |
| ----------- | ---------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- |
| Name        | get                                                                                                                                |
| Verb        | read                                                                                                                               |
| Description | Get the timezone of the host                                                                                                       |
| Detail      | Reads the IANA name of the timezone and its offset from UTC now: the zone that /etc/localtime links to, or /etc/timezone on Linux. |
| HTTP        | GET                                                                                                                                |
| Route       | /api/node/&#123;hostname&#125;/timezone                                                                                            |
| Permission  | timezone:read                                                                                                                      |
| Command     | [osapi client node timezone get](../../../../usage/cli/client/node/timezone/get.md)                                                |
| Input type  | GetInput                                                                                                                           |
| Output type | Entry                                                                                                                              |

### Input (0)

None. The method takes no input; its command needs only --target.

### Output (2)

| FIELD      | TYPE   | DESCRIPTION                                             |
| ---------- | ------ | ------------------------------------------------------- |
| timezone   | string | The IANA name of the timezone, such as America/New_York |
| utc_offset | string | The offset from UTC now, such as -05:00                 |

### Examples (2)

| EXAMPLE             | INPUT  | OUTPUT                          |
| ------------------- | ------ | ------------------------------- |
| A Linux host on UTC | (none) | timezone=UTC, utc_offset=+00:00 |
| A Mac on UTC        | (none) | timezone=UTC, utc_offset=+00:00 |

## Method update

|             |                                                                                                                                                                                                                         |
| ----------- | ----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- |
| Name        | update                                                                                                                                                                                                                  |
| Verb        | write                                                                                                                                                                                                                   |
| Description | Set the timezone of the host                                                                                                                                                                                            |
| Detail      | Sets the timezone with timedatectl set-timezone. A host that already has the timezone, as gohai reads it, does not change and reports changed: false. It runs on the Debian family only, and elsewhere reports skipped. |
| HTTP        | PUT                                                                                                                                                                                                                     |
| Route       | /api/node/&#123;hostname&#125;/timezone                                                                                                                                                                                 |
| Permission  | timezone:write                                                                                                                                                                                                          |
| Command     | [osapi client node timezone update](../../../../usage/cli/client/node/timezone/update.md)                                                                                                                               |
| Input type  | UpdateInput                                                                                                                                                                                                             |
| Output type | Result                                                                                                                                                                                                                  |

### Input (1)

| FIELD    | TYPE   | REQUIRED | CONSTRAINTS                                                                   | DESCRIPTION                                                    |
| -------- | ------ | -------- | ----------------------------------------------------------------------------- | -------------------------------------------------------------- |
| timezone | string | yes      | pattern ^\[A-Za-z0-9_+]\[A-Za-z0-9_+-]\*(/\[A-Za-z0-9_+-]+)\*$, max length 64 | The IANA name of the timezone, such as UTC or America/New_York |

### Output (2)

| FIELD    | TYPE    | DESCRIPTION              |
| -------- | ------- | ------------------------ |
| timezone | string  | The timezone of the host |
| changed  | boolean | Whether the host changed |

### Examples (2)

| EXAMPLE                              | INPUT                     | OUTPUT                                  |
| ------------------------------------ | ------------------------- | --------------------------------------- |
| Set a new timezone                   | timezone=America/New_York | timezone=America/New_York, changed=true |
| A host that already has the timezone | timezone=UTC              | timezone=UTC, changed=false             |
